# Pack vectors, emitted by the AUTHORITY: freenet-contracts `block::pack::build`.
#
# `engine/src/pack.rs` is a second spelling of a format defined by the Block
# contract, which is what actually refuses a malformed pack. Two spellings of
# one format drift, and the drift shows up as a host refusing a commit -- so
# the engine's output is pinned against bytes the contract itself produced,
# not against the engine's own idea of them.
#
# Regenerate (from a checkout of freenet-contracts at the pinned rev):
#   cd block && cargo test --test emit_pack_vectors -- --nocapture | grep '^VEC'
#
# Each line: VEC <case> <pack body, hex>
